title: Sen gelecek diye

characters.MOM: a mother in her late fifties with dark hair streaked with grey in a short bob, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan and a floral apron
characters.DAUGHTER: a young woman of about twenty-seven with long chestnut hair, wearing a forest green coat

scenes.text:
Sen gelecek diye annen,
bir gün önceden yorulur.
scenes.prompt: In the early morning, {MOM} stands on a small stool hanging freshly washed white curtains at a living room window, autumn trees outside, soft light.

scenes.text:
Perdeleri yıkar, yatağını serer,
sevdiğin yemeği akşamdan hazırlar.
scenes.prompt: In a cozy kitchen at evening, {MOM} stirs a big pot on the stove, several covered dishes waiting on the table beside her, warm lamp light, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Sen iki gün kalırsın,
sonra o kocaman sofra tek kişilik olur.
scenes.prompt: At a long wooden dining table in warm lamp light, {MOM} sits alone at one end with a single plate, the empty chairs around her, autumn rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Senin için kısa bir ziyaret;
onun için bir bayram.
scenes.prompt: On a golden autumn afternoon, {MOM} waits at the open front door of a small house with a garden, smiling widely as {DAUGHTER} walks up the path with a small suitcase.

scenes.text:
Bu sefer bir gün fazla kal.
Bunu annene gönder, geleceğini müjdele.
scenes.prompt: At sunset in a garden full of autumn leaves, {DAUGHTER} on the left and {MOM} on the right sit side by side on a wooden bench, laughing together, golden light.

caption:
Annen yoruldu mu?

Sen gelecek diye bütün ev bayram olur. 🤍

Bunu annene gönder, geleceğini müjdele.
